privacy.delete_prompt:
⚠️ **Delete your data?**

This erases your portfolio, sales history, settings, activity log and alert history. It cannot be undone. Payment records and a paid plan stay.
privacy.deleted: ✅ Your data has been deleted. Send /start any time to begin again.
privacy.paysupport:
💳 **Payment support**

Problem with a Stars payment or want a refund? Write to the bot owner and include the date of the payment and the plan. Refunds are returned to your Telegram Stars balance and end the paid plan.

risk.title: Risk
risk.style_bold_desc: Ready for swings to grow faster
risk.empty:
Your portfolio is empty. Add coins in «💼 Portfolio» and you will see here what you are risking.

🎯 The trade plan works without a portfolio too.
risk.missing_prices: No price for: {coins}. These coins are not counted.
risk.size_prompt:
✏️ Your own numbers. Send the coin, entry price and stop (where you admit the mistake and sell). Take-profit is optional.
Example: SOL 105 100 115
If your portfolio is empty, add a deposit with $: SOL 105 100 $100
risk.size_loss: If the stop hits: −{loss} (your risk on {account})
risk.size_capped: The amount was cut by your single-coin limit.
risk.size_format_hint: I did not understand. Send: coin, entry, stop and optionally take-profit, e.g. SOL 105 100 115
risk.size_need_deposit: Your portfolio is empty. Add a deposit with $, e.g. SOL 105 100 $100
risk.size_reject_stop_not_below_entry: The stop must be below the entry price: the bot sizes buys only.
risk.size_reject_below_min_notional: That is below Binance's minimum order (about $5). Move the stop closer or use a larger deposit.
risk.size_reject_new_entry_blocked_by_drawdow: Defensive mode: new buys are paused until the portfolio recovers.
risk.size_reject_no_headroom_under_caps: This coin already reached your concentration limit.
risk.size_reject_unknown: Could not size a trade with these numbers.

risk.light_defensive: 🔴 Defense: drawdown −{dd}%. New buys are paused.
risk.over_limit: ⚠️ {symbol} is {weight}% of the portfolio. For your style, better at most {limit}%
